Landing Page = 
"
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang='en'>
<head>
<meta charset='UTF-8'>
<meta name='viewport' content='width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0'>
<title>Enterprise Sales Performance Dashboard</title>
<style>
  :root{
    --primary:#F24D18;
    --primary-light:#FF8B5E;
    --gold:#F4A73C;
    --teal:#2A9D8F;
    --purple:#7C6B96;
    --tint:#FFE3D1;
    --bg:#F7F5F3;
    --surface:rgba(255,255,255,0.55);
    --surface-solid:#FFFFFF;
    --card-border:rgba(255,255,255,0.6);
    --text-primary:#3A3345;
    --text-secondary:#8A8489;
    --success:#2A9D8F;
    --warning:#F4A73C;
    --danger:#D64545;
    --shadow:0 8px 32px rgba(58,51,69,0.10);
    --shadow-lg:0 20px 60px rgba(58,51,69,0.16);
  }
  *{margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box;}
  html,body{
    width:100%;height:100%;overflow:hidden;
    font-family:'Segoe UI',-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'SF Pro Display',Roboto,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;
    background:var(--bg);
    color:var(--text-primary);
  }
  .stage{
    position:relative;width:100%;height:100vh;
    display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
    background:
      radial-gradient(1200px 600px at 15% 10%, rgba(242,77,24,0.10), transparent 60%),
      radial-gradient(1000px 500px at 85% 15%, rgba(42,157,143,0.10), transparent 60%),
      radial-gradient(900px 700px at 50% 100%, rgba(124,107,150,0.08), transparent 60%),
      var(--bg);
    overflow:hidden;
  }
  .blob{
    position:absolute;border-radius:50%;filter:blur(60px);opacity:0.35;
    animation:float 14s ease-in-out infinite;
  }
  .blob1{width:340px;height:340px;background:var(--primary-light);top:-80px;left:-60px;animation-delay:0s;}
  .blob2{width:280px;height:280px;background:var(--teal);bottom:-60px;right:-40px;animation-delay:3s;}
  .blob3{width:220px;height:220px;background:var(--purple);top:55%;left:78%;animation-delay:6s;}
  .blob4{width:180px;height:180px;background:var(--gold);top:70%;left:8%;animation-delay:9s;}

  @keyframes float{
    0%,100%{transform:translate(0,0) scale(1);}
    33%{transform:translate(30px,-25px) scale(1.06);}
    66%{transform:translate(-20px,20px) scale(0.96);}
  }

  .content{
    position:relative;z-index:2;width:min(1180px,92vw);
    display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;text-align:center;
    animation:fadeIn 1s ease both;
  }
  @keyframes fadeIn{from{opacity:0;}to{opacity:1;}}
  @keyframes slideUp{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(24px);}to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0);}}

  .logo-wrap{
    animation:slideUp 0.8s ease 0.1s both;
    margin-bottom:14px;
  }
  .logo-wrap img{height:46px;display:block;filter:drop-shadow(0 4px 14px rgba(58,51,69,0.12));}

  .eyebrow{
    animation:slideUp 0.8s ease 0.2s both;
    font-size:12px;letter-spacing:2.5px;font-weight:600;
    color:var(--primary);text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:14px;
  }

  h1{
    animation:slideUp 0.8s ease 0.3s both;
    font-size:clamp(28px,4.2vw,52px);font-weight:700;line-height:1.08;
    letter-spacing:-0.5px;margin-bottom:14px;
    background:linear-gradient(120deg,var(--text-primary) 30%, var(--primary) 65%, var(--gold) 100%);
    -webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent;
  }

  .subtitle{
    animation:slideUp 0.8s ease 0.4s both;
    font-size:clamp(14px,1.6vw,19px);font-weight:500;color:var(--text-primary);
    opacity:0.85;margin-bottom:8px;
  }

  .description{
    animation:slideUp 0.8s ease 0.5s both;
    font-size:clamp(12px,1.15vw,14.5px);color:var(--text-secondary);
    max-width:620px;line-height:1.6;margin-bottom:26px;
  }

  .cta{
    animation:slideUp 0.8s ease 0.6s both;
    position:relative;overflow:hidden;
    display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;
    padding:13px 30px;border:none;border-radius:999px;cursor:pointer;
    font-size:14.5px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:0.2px;color:#fff;
    background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--primary),var(--gold));
    box-shadow:0 10px 30px rgba(242,77,24,0.35),0 2px 8px rgba(242,77,24,0.25);
    transition:transform 0.25s ease, box-shadow 0.25s ease;
    margin-bottom:38px;
  }
  .cta:hover{
    transform:translateY(-2px) scale(1.03);
    box-shadow:0 16px 40px rgba(242,77,24,0.45),0 4px 14px rgba(242,77,24,0.3);
  }
  .cta:active{transform:translateY(0) scale(0.98);}
  .cta .ripple{
    position:absolute;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(255,255,255,0.55);
    transform:scale(0);pointer-events:none;
    animation:ripple 0.6s ease-out;
  }
  @keyframes ripple{to{transform:scale(4);opacity:0;}}
  .cta::after{
    content:'';position:absolute;top:0;left:-60%;width:40%;height:100%;
    background:linear-gradient(120deg,transparent,rgba(255,255,255,0.55),transparent);
    transform:skewX(-20deg);
    animation:shimmer 3.2s ease-in-out infinite;
  }
  @keyframes shimmer{0%{left:-60%;}100%{left:130%;}}

  .cards{
    animation:slideUp 0.8s ease 0.7s both;
    display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(7,minmax(0,1fr));gap:12px;
    width:100%;
  }
  .card{
    position:relative;background:var(--surface);
    border:1px solid var(--card-border);
    border-radius:16px;padding:16px 10px 14px;
    backdrop-filter:blur(16px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(16px);
    box-shadow:var(--shadow);
    display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:8px;
    transition:transform 0.3s ease, box-shadow 0.3s ease, background 0.3s ease;
    cursor:pointer;
  }
  .card:hover{
    transform:translateY(-6px);
    box-shadow:var(--shadow-lg);
    background:rgba(255,255,255,0.85);
  }
  .card .icon-wrap{
    width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:11px;
    display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
    box-shadow:0 4px 14px rgba(0,0,0,0.08);
  }
  .card svg{width:19px;height:19px;}
  .card .label{font-size:11.5px;font-weight:600;color:var(--text-primary);}
  .card .tag{font-size:9.5px;color:var(--text-secondary);}

  .c-sales .icon-wrap{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--primary),var(--primary-light));}
  .c-profit .icon-wrap{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--teal),#5ec4b6);}
  .c-products .icon-wrap{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--gold),#ffcf7a);}
  .c-customers .icon-wrap{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--purple),#a595c4);}
  .c-stores .icon-wrap{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--primary-light),var(--tint));}
  .c-employees .icon-wrap{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#6b7fd7,#9db0ef);}
  .c-promotions .icon-wrap{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#e0577b,#f2a3b8);}

  footer{
    position:absolute;bottom:14px;left:0;right:0;z-index:2;
    text-align:center;font-size:10.5px;color:var(--text-secondary);
    animation:fadeIn 1.2s ease 1s both;
  }
  footer b{color:var(--text-primary);}

  @media (max-width:900px){
    .cards{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));}
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<div class='stage'>

  <div class='blob blob3'></div>

  <div class='content'>

        <div class='icon-wrap'>

        </div>
        <div class='label'>Stores</div>

      <div class='card c-employees'>
        <div class='icon-wrap'>
          <svg viewBox='0 0 24 24' fill='none' stroke='#fff' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round'><rect x='2' y='7' width='20' height='14' rx='2'></rect><path d='M16 21V5a2 2 0 00-2-2h-4a2 2 0 00-2 2v16'></path></svg>

      <div class='card c-promotions'>
        <div class='icon-wrap'>
          <svg viewBox='0 0 24 24' fill='none' stroke='#fff' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round'><path d='M20.59 13.41L11 3.83A2 2 0 009.59 3.17H4a1 1 0 00-1 1v5.59a2 2 0 00.59 1.41l9.58 9.58a2 2 0 002.82 0l4.6-4.6a2 2 0 000-2.82z'></path><circle cx='7.5' cy='7.5' r='1.5'></circle></svg>
        </div>
        <div class='label'>Promotions</div>

    </div>

  </div>

  <footer>Designed &amp; developed by <b>Abdelrahman Gaballah</b> &mdash; Senior Data Analyst</footer>

</div>

<script>
function rippleFx(e){
  var btn = e.currentTarget;
  var circle = document.createElement('span');
  var rect = btn.getBoundingClientRect();
  var size = Math.max(rect.width, rect.height);
  circle.style.width = circle.style.height = size + 'px';
  circle.style.left = (e.clientX - rect.left - size/2) + 'px';
  circle.style.top = (e.clientY - rect.top - size/2) + 'px';
  circle.className = 'ripple';
  btn.appendChild(circle);
  setTimeout(function(){ circle.remove(); }, 650);
}
</script>
</body>
</html>

"
